name: music-bridge-for-roon
description: Local proof of concept: NetEase Cloud Music account playback into a selected Roon zone through Roon Audio Input.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm@10.17.1 --filter @music-bridge/contracts run build && corepack pnpm@10.17.1 --filter @music-bridge/bridge-core run build && corepack pnpm@10.17.1 --filter @music-bridge/desktop run build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm@10.17.1 --filter @music-bridge/contracts run typecheck && corepack pnpm@10.17.1 --filter @music-bridge/bridge-core run typecheck && corepack pnpm@10.17.1 --filter @music-bridge/desktop run typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm@10.17.1 --filter @music-bridge/contracts run test && corepack pnpm@10.17.1 --filter @music-bridge/bridge-core run test && corepack pnpm@10.17.1 --filter @music-bridge/desktop run test
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm@10.17.1 run typecheck && corepack pnpm@10.17.1 run test && corepack pnpm@10.17.1 run build
